ava_fm_001.speaker: ava_chen
ava_fm_001.text: You look like you've come a long way. Haven Ridge doesn't get many travellers who aren't running from something.

choices.text: Just looking for work and a roof.
[Speech 50] I heard Haven Ridge is the last decent place left.
What about you? What are you running from?

ava_fm_002a.speaker: ava_chen
ava_fm_002a.text: Honest. I can work with that. Talk to Councilman Falk about labour assignments — he keeps the lists.

ava_fm_002b_pass.speaker: ava_chen
ava_fm_002b_pass.text: It is, or it was. We're trying to keep it that way. If you're willing to help with that, you might be useful.

ava_fm_002b_fail.speaker: ava_chen
ava_fm_002b_fail.text: Pretty words. We'll see. Don't make promises about this place until you've earned the right to make them.

ava_fm_002c.speaker: ava_chen
ava_fm_002c.text: Ha. Nothing. This is exactly where I chose to be. Not everyone out here is fleeing something.

ava_fm_003_signal.speaker: ava_chen
ava_fm_003_signal.text: Before you go — have you heard it? The signal. It started about two months ago. Repeating broadcast, direction uncertain. Falk says it's nothing. I'm not sure I believe him.

choices.text: Tell me more about this signal.
Sounds like nothing. I'll keep my head down.

ava_fm_004a.speaker: ava_chen
ava_fm_004a.text: It repeats every few hours. Same fragment of audio, then silence. Some of the older folks say it sounds like a distress call. Others say it's automated, like a pre-war beacon. Nobody's tried to find it. Not yet.

ava_fm_004b.speaker: ava_chen
ava_fm_004b.text: Fair enough. But if curiosity gets the better of you, come find me. I'd like to know where it's coming from.

ava_med_001.speaker: ava_chen
ava_med_001.text: You look roughed up. Here — I've got a field dressing with your name on it. No charge. Think of it as a welcome gift.

choices.text: [Medicine 40] I know how to treat my own wounds.

ava_med_002a.speaker: ava_chen
ava_med_002a.text: Don't mention it. The people who say they're fine are usually the ones who bleed out quietly. Come back if anything opens up.

ava_med_002b_pass.speaker: ava_chen
ava_med_002b_pass.text: Good. Then you know when to use it and when not to. Smart. Take it anyway — you might need it for someone else.

ava_med_002b_fail.speaker: ava_chen
ava_med_002b_fail.text: You sure about that? I've seen that look before. Take the dressing. Pride heals slower than wounds do.

ava_tr_001.speaker: ava_chen
ava_tr_001.text: Need patching up, or restocking? I keep medical supplies and ammo on hand. What can I do for you?

choices.text: Show me what supplies you have.
Any more word on that signal?

ava_tr_trade.speaker: ava_chen
ava_tr_trade.text: Fair prices — I don't gouge people who keep this place alive. Take a look.

ava_tr_signal.speaker: ava_chen
ava_tr_signal.text: Same as ever — it repeats, then silence. If you find where it's coming from, you tell me first. Not Falk.

ava_tr_bye.speaker: ava_chen
ava_tr_bye.text: Stay in one piece out there.
